_doc: Release gate symbol list (release-gates.cjs --probe-free). Any test-only log/probe wrapped in /*QF_PROBE_BEGIN*/…/*QF_PROBE_END*/ is stripped generically by strip-probes.cjs; ADD its unique log tag / global here so the release build is proven free of it. literal = plain substring; regex = JS regex source. Never list tags that predate the probes and ship on purpose (e.g. the BalloonTransit [QF_B1_GAP] totalMs summary, bdd3c6d7).
_formalDoc: FORMAL release only (FORMAL_RELEASE=1, release-gates.cjs --formal-free): code wrapped in /*QF_TRIAL_BEGIN*/…/*QF_TRIAL_END*/ (the shared __qfPreTransition / ?qfPre= test entry and every comment naming it) ships in trial/develop uploads and is stripped from a formal release. qfPre covers __qfPreTransition, qfPre= and the journal-sky hook docs; QF_TRIAL = leftover markers. ([QF_PRE] is NOT listed: frozen WorldIntegrationBoot.ts and WorldNativeComposition.ts log it on test-only paths; changing them needs Grok Bot's diff approval.)
